source_span: We begin our list as follows, $$1 \quad \underline{\hphantom{10}} \quad \dots \quad \underline{\hphantom{10}} \quad 14.$$  Checking $2$, we find that $2\cdot 7=14$, so our list becomes $$1 \quad 2 \quad \underline{\hphantom{10}} \quad \dots \quad \underline{\hphantom{10}} \quad 7 \quad 14.$$  Checking $3$, $4$, $5$, and $6$, we find that none of these are divisors of $14$, so our final list is $$1 \quad 2 \quad 7 \quad 14.$$  Next, we use the buddy method to determine the factors of $42$.
